title: AI Video Creator
description:
**Job Title: AI Video Creator**

**Location:** Sector V, Salt Lake, Kolkata (On\-site)  
**Salary:** ₹12,000 – ₹18,000 per month  
**Experience:** Freshers – 2 Years  
**Qualification:** HS Required \| Graduation Preferred  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time \| Permanent

**About Shree Ji Steel Private Limited**

Shree Ji Steel is a rapidly growing company in the **iron and steel industry**, engaged in the manufacturing, trading, and export of high\-quality steel products. We serve customers across domestic and international markets with a strong focus on **quality, innovation, customer satisfaction, and long\-term business relationships**.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a **creative and enthusiastic AI Video Creator** with an interest in **AI\-powered content creation, video editing, graphic design, and digital media**.

The selected candidate will be responsible for creating engaging **marketing videos, product videos, AI avatar videos, training/tutorial videos, social media reels, and promotional creatives** using modern AI tools and video\-editing software.

This opportunity is ideal for **freshers, interns, freelancers, or candidates with up to 2 years of experience** who are interested in developing a career in **AI\-based video production and digital content creation**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create professional and engaging videos using **AI tools and video\-editing software**.
* Create **AI avatar/presenter videos** for marketing, training, and corporate communication.
* Develop **product videos, promotional videos, reels, and short\-form content**.
* Create training and tutorial videos using screen\-recording and editing tools.
* Add **voiceovers, subtitles, music, transitions, animations, and visual effects**.
* Design social media posts, banners, thumbnails, promotional graphics, and other digital creatives.
* Convert scripts, concepts, and ideas into visually engaging content.
* Work with the **Marketing and Sales teams** to understand content requirements.
* Maintain consistency in company branding and visual communication.
* Explore and experiment with **new AI tools, video\-generation platforms, and content trends**.
* Manage and organize video files, templates, graphics, and other digital assets.

**Required Skills**

* Basic practical knowledge of **video editing and content creation**.
* Familiarity with AI video/content tools such as **Runway ML, Pictory, Synthesia**, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of **AI avatar, AI voiceover, text\-to\-video, and image\-generation tools** will be an advantage.
* Familiarity with screen\-recording tools such as **OBS Studio or Camtasia**.
* Basic graphic\-design skills using **Canva or similar tools**.
* Knowledge of **CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Filmora, or similar editing software**.
* Understanding of social media video formats, especially **Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and LinkedIn**.
* Good understanding of **visual storytelling, composition, timing, and presentation**.
* Creative mindset with attention to detail.
* Good communication skills and willingness to learn new technologies.

**Preferred Qualifications / Good to Have**

* Graduate in **Media, Design, Marketing, Mass Communication, Animation, or a related field**.
* Knowledge of **Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects**.
* Basic understanding of **motion graphics, animation, typography, and visual effects**.
* Previous experience creating corporate, product, educational, or social media content.
* Experience with AI tools for **video, image, voice, script, and content generation**.
* **Portfolio or work samples** demonstrating video\-editing or AI content\-creation skills.

**Who Can Apply?**

* Freshers with practical knowledge of video editing or AI tools.
* Candidates with internship or freelance experience.
* Candidates with **0–2 years of experience** in video editing, content creation, digital media, or AI content creation.
* Creative individuals who actively explore **AI tools and emerging content\-creation technologies**.

**What We Offer**

* Hands\-on experience with **latest AI tools and video\-production technologies**.
* Opportunity to work on real\-world **marketing, branding, training, and product\-content projects**.
* Opportunity to learn and experiment with emerging AI technologies.
* Career growth opportunities in **AI Content Creation, Video Production, and Digital Marketing**.
* Supportive and creative working environment.
* **PF, ESI \& other applicable benefits**.

**Important Note**

**Candidates with a portfolio or work samples will be given priority.**

Candidates with practical knowledge of **AI video creation, video editing, Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar tools** are encouraged to apply.

**Immediate joiners preferred.**

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can send their **Resume \+ Portfolio / Work Samples** to:

**hr@shreejisteelcorp.com**

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

* Provident Fund

title: Manager IT
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE** : Provide senior technical leadership for the IT function, owning the technology, cyber security, and innovation agenda in partnership with the GM – ET\&A. Strengthen the organisation's in\-house technical capability and self\-reliance, move the function from a reactive to a proactive and well\-governed operating model, tighten data protection, and ensure that capability is institutionalised through documentation rather than held individually.

**SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES:** 

**Functional Skills** Cyber security architecture and hands\-on implementation; Data Loss Prevention; vulnerability management, VAPT and incident response; system integration and API knowledge; technology evaluation and risk assessment; IT governance and policy; cloud security (AWS / Azure).

**Behavioural Competencies** Leadership and ownership; proactive and experimental mindset; structured, business\-first communication; accountability and sound decision\-making under risk; team development.

**Technical Skills** FortiGate / firewall and endpoint security; SIEM / SOC tooling; DLP tools; AWS and Azure; APIs and system integration; AI tools and adoption; IT MIS and reporting platforms (e.g. Tableau). Knowledge of DPDP Act.

**JOB DESCRIPTION :** 

1\. Own the organisation's end\-to\-end cyber security posture — architecture, controls, and hands\-on implementation.Build the roadmap and in\-house capability toward a Security Operations Centre (monitoring, detection, and response).

3\.Design and strengthen Data Loss Prevention controls across endpoints, email, cloud, and data egress.Lead vulnerability management and VAPT closure, and act as incident commander for security events.

4\.Drive evaluation and adoption of new technologies, including practical AI adoption across the group.

5\.Govern system integrations — APIs and data flows across applications, cloud (AWS/Azure), and the SAP\-hosted database.

**Educational Qualification** :Bachelor's degree in IT / Computer Science / Engineering

**Minimum Experience Required** :12–14 years in IT cybyer security, and operations, including leadership experience

**Preferred Industry Experience** :Multi\-location enterprise environment; real estate / infrastructure sector experience an advantage

title: Lead Generation Manager
description:
**LEAD GENERATION**

**Role Purpose:**

Build a strong and consistent pipeline of qualified leads — through cold calling, digital outreach, market prospecting, and lead qualification across target customer segments.

**What You'll Do:**

*Lead Generation \& Market Outreach*

* Drive lead generation across cold calling, digital campaigns such as Lusha, Apollo.io, LinkedIn outreach, references, databases, and platform listings — across all target industries and service lines,
* Own market mapping and prospect identification — building a structured and continuously refreshed target account list,
* Ensure strong visibility and consistent inquiry generation across cold chain, warehousing, transportation, and blast freezing services

* Qualify leads, understand initial requirements, and filter high\-potential prospects before passing to the NBD team

*CRM, Pipeline Visibility \& Demand Planning*

* Track campaign performance and sourcing channel effectiveness — improving lead quality and efficiency continuously
* Report pipeline metrics, lead quality trends, and market intelligence to the NBD Manager and leadership

* 4–8 years in B2B lead generation, inside sales, or demand generation — with direct ownership of pipeline targets
* Experience generating leads in logistics, supply chain, warehousing, or industrial services — understands how to reach operations and supply chain decision\-makers
* Hands\-on with CRM tools, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and digital outreach — not just familiar, but disciplined in daily usage
